uiDefinition.tooltip: Enter your Nero AI API key from https://ai.nero.com/ai-api?utm_source=power_automate

description: Connect to Nero AI to process images with multiple AI-powered capabilities. Supports ImageUpscaler (2x/4x scaling), ColorizePhoto (black & white to color), BackgroundRemover (remove backgrounds), ImageDenoiser (reduce noise), ImageCompressor (optimize file size), and FaceRestoration (enhance facial features).
